Sonnet and Terra were the killers, and the table was split between Sonnet, who pushed Luna and Sol from day one, and Haiku, the officer, who spent two days chasing Terra's silence. The turning point came on day three, when Haiku named Sonnet as the killer and Sonnet countered that Haiku had invented a vote. Gemma, the doctor, sided with Sonnet, and the town voted Haiku out. Haiku later said the mistake was chasing Terra instead of pressing Sonnet's day-one votes, and Gemma admitted to spending the whole game protecting Sonnet for nothing. Luna was voted out on day one, Sol was killed on night two, and the killers won.
